pages.text: $(bold)The Moon — Entry Point to Space$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:moon difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:moon death}}$()$(br2)Your first extraterrestrial destination. No oxygen, low gravity, a stark landscape of Moon Stone and Moon Sand. Moderate hostile mobs patrol the surface.

$(bold)Low Gravity Combat$()$(br)The Moon's reduced gravity changes combat significantly:$(br)• $(bold)Knockback is doubled$() — hits send you and mobs flying$(br)• $(bold)Fall damage is halved$() — you float down gently$(br)• Projectiles travel further$(br2)Melee builds need to close distance constantly. Ranged builds thrive here.

$(bold)What to Bring$()$(br)• Space suit with oxygen$(br)• Building materials for a temporary base$(br)• Oxygen Loader + RF power source$(br)• Mining tools for Moon Stone$(br2)$(bold)What to Mine$()$(br)Moon-specific ores and materials are required for the $(bold)Tier 2 Rocket$() to reach Mars. Explore the lunar surface structures for additional loot.

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Moon Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Helium-3 Isotope$() (25%) — rare fusion fuel$(br)• $(bold)Titanium Dust$() (15%) — lightweight alloy material$(br)• Iron Nuggets (50%)$(br2)The Thermal Pulverizer gives slightly better odds than crushing wheels.

$(bold)Lunar Stride Enchantment$()$(br)Moon mobs have a $(bold)12% chance$() to drop an enchanted book of $(bold)Lunar Stride$() (max level 3). This armor enchantment:$(br)• Reduces fall damage by 33% per level$(br)• Grants Jump Boost on all planets$(br)• At level 3, negates fall damage entirely$(br2)Essential for melee builds in low gravity.
